SPOR

240minutes
42solder joints
difficulty

ArduPilot avionics for an RC truck that drives itself

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

16SPOR-WIRE-1

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    +GND5VGND4V5GND4V5.2GND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    +Power plug + · Autopilot Vbat
    GNDPower plug - · Autopilot G.5
    MAV_TXWi-Fi link D6 · Autopilot Rx1
    MAV_RXWi-Fi link D7 · Autopilot Tx1
    5VAutopilot 5V · Wi-Fi link 5V
    GNDAutopilot G.3 · Wi-Fi link GND
    4V5Autopilot 4V5 · RC receiver 5V
    GNDAutopilot G · RC receiver G
    CRSF_INRC receiver TX · Autopilot Rx2
    CRSF_OUTAutopilot Tx2 · RC receiver RX
    4V5.2Autopilot 4V5.2 · GNSS + compass 5V
    GNDAutopilot G.2 · GNSS + compass G
    GPS_INGNSS + compass TX · Autopilot Rx3
    GPS_OUTAutopilot Tx3 · GNSS + compass RX
    COMPASS_SCLAutopilot SCL · GNSS + compass CL
    COMPASS_SDAAutopilot SDA · GNSS + compass DA
    STEERINGAutopilot S1 · Servo rail S1
    THROTTLEAutopilot S3 · Servo rail S3
    GNDAutopilot G.4 · Servo rail G1 · Servo rail G3
    srv_V1Servo rail V1 · Servo rail V3
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
17SPOR-WIRE-1

Spor is built

Spor is the autopilot box for an outdoor ArduPilot Rover built on a 1:10 RC truck. A Matek H7A3-SLIM runs ArduPilot Rover, an M9N GNSS and compass on a mast tells it where it is and which way it faces, an ExpressLRS receiver keeps you in manual control, and a XIAO ESP32-C3 links it to a laptop ground station over Wi-Fi. Drive it by hand, then let it follow a short waypoint route you plan in Mission Planner or QGroundControl.
